Welcome to Sunrise

A Legacy of Learning & Character

Sunrise Public School, Darbhanga has been a beacon of quality education for over two decades. Affiliated to CBSE, we blend academic rigour with values, sports, and the arts — shaping confident, compassionate young citizens.

Our modern campus features smart classrooms, well-equipped science and computer labs, a rich library, and expansive play areas — everything a growing mind needs.

About Our School

A legacy of excellence since 1998

Home  /  About Us
Who We Are

Building minds, building the nation

Founded in 1998, Sunrise Public School began with a vision — to bring quality, affordable CBSE education to the families of Darbhanga. Today, we stand as one of the region's most trusted institutions, with 1,800+ students and a team of 85 dedicated educators.

Our philosophy is simple: every child is unique. We combine strong academics with sports, cultural activities, and life-skills education so our students excel in every field they choose.

From our first batch of 40 students to thousands of successful alumni — the Sunrise journey continues with the same passion.

25+Years
Foundation

Vision, Mission & Values

🔭

Our Vision

To be a centre of educational excellence where every student discovers their potential and grows into a responsible global citizen rooted in Indian values.

🎯

Our Mission

To provide holistic, affordable education that blends academic rigour with character building, creativity, and community service.

💎

Core Values

Discipline · Integrity · Compassion · Curiosity · Respect — the five pillars on which every Sunrise student stands tall.
